editorial:
Imagine finding out the world is ending in six months, but nobody seems to care. You get to follow two scientists who discover a giant rock heading straight for Earth. They try to tell the president and the news, but everyone is too busy with social media and celebrity gossip to listen. It feels like a wild ride because it mixes scary stakes with really funny, awkward moments. You will see a world that is so distracted by nonsense that it forgets how to survive, making the whole thing feel like a weird mirror of our own lives today.

Leonardo DiCaprio and Jennifer Lawrence are great here, playing people who are just stressed out and confused. The movie moves quickly, though some parts might feel a bit too long if you aren't into the political jokes. If you want a movie that makes you laugh and then makes you feel a bit nervous, you should definitely give this a go. It looks amazing in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the end, the government tries to stop the comet to mine it for expensive minerals, but the plan fails miserably. The comet hits Earth, destroying everything and everyone. Before the impact, the main characters have one last dinner with their loved ones, talking about how they missed the simple things in life. It is a sad and blunt ending that shows that being greedy and ignoring science leads to total disaster.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves smart comedies that poke fun at modern society.
